items.prompt: Choose the natural reply: Can you drive? — ___
options: I am able to drive can.
items.explanation: The verb phrase collapses to the auxiliary: I can.

items.prompt: Write one word: Will they finish on time? — I hope ___.
items.explanation: 'I hope so' substitutes the whole clause with 'so'.

items.prompt: Choose the correct completion: She plays guitar, and her brother ___ too.
Write one word: I need a charger. Do you have ___?

options: The flat at the top is bigger than the one at the bottom.
The flat at the top is bigger than the one at the bottom one.
The flat at the top is bigger than the one at the bottom flat.
The flat at the top is bigger than it at the bottom.
items.explanation: 'The one' substitutes 'the flat' in the comparison.

items.prompt: Choose the correct reply: Who fixed the printer? — ___
items.explanation: Short answer with substitution: I did.

items.prompt: In which situation is ellipsis most natural?
items.explanation: Speech allows aggressive ellipsis; formal writing avoids it.
